finding: 35 miRNA entries modulated across 2, 4 and 9 dpe, with sequences, logFC and p in Table 1.
exact_quote: The number of significantly modulated miRNAs increased from 5 or fewer at 2 and 4 dpe to 23 unique miRNAs by 9 dpe.
coverage_gap: Reads mapped to miRBase 17 and named per release 19, so several arm labels disagree with the sequence.

finding: 16 miRNAs with >2-fold change between DENV-2 blood meal (D) and regular blood meal (B) midguts; 13 up, 3 down.
exact_quote: Table 5 Significantly modulated miRNAs that displayed a < -2- or > 2-fold difference in expression between the midguts of mosquitoes that had ingested a DENV-2-infected blood meal (D) and those that had ingested a regular blood meal (B)
coverage_gap: Sequences come from the paper's Additional file 1 (Drive copy); miR-6134 is not in that file.

finding: 17 significant DE miRNAs between infected and uninfected midguts after the same DENV-2 meal; 15 up, 2 down.
exact_quote: Of these miRNAs, 15 were upregulated (miR-1420b-5p, miR-1767, miR-193-5p, miR-1951, miR-19c, miR-276-3p, miR-2941, miR-3811e-5p, miR-4110-5p, miR-424-3p, miR-5706, miR-6134, miR-622, miR-976-5p and miR-989) and two were downregulated (miR-1273f and miR-4448).
coverage_gap: No sequences in the paper; values and day (5/7/10 d) per miRNA are in Fig. 1b / Additional file 5, not available. Sequences used are guesses from Su et al. 2017 Additional file 1.

finding: 66 known DE miRNAs (15 up, 51 down) plus 4 novel; 12 named in the text with >50-fold change and 7 validated by RT-qPCR.
exact_quote: Based on p-value and log fold change, 66 known miRNAs (15 for up-regulated and 51 for down-regulated) and 4 novel candidate miRNAs (3 for up-regulated and 1 for down-regulated) were differentially expressed
coverage_gap: Full list of 66 with values and sequences is in a supplement not in Zotero (unavailable).

finding: Only 3 DE miRNAs in midgut at 1 dpi: miR-989 down, miR-2943 up, miR-2941 down.
exact_quote: a total of 85 known miRNAs were identified, with three known miRNAs differentially expressed (Table S5)

finding: 12 miRNAs measured by RT-qPCR. C6/36 24 hpi: only miR-1891 down, the rest up. Adult females 7 dpi: different pattern.
exact_quote: After infection, only miR-1891 was down-regulated and the remaining miRNAs were up-regulated (Fig. 1).
quote_locator: Results, p.4; Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 (significance read from asterisks)
coverage_gap: Sequences/primers are in a supplementary TIFF on Drive, not transcribed. Text says miR-1889 and let-7 rise in females but Fig. 2 shows no asterisk for them.

finding: miR-281 up-regulated in midgut after DENV-2.
exact_quote: miR-281 has been found to be specifically expressed at a high level in the midgut of female adult mosquitoes and is up-regulated after DENV-2 infection.
coverage_gap: Arm not stated in the main text.

finding: 11 miRNAs DE in persistently infected C6-L cells vs both controls, plus 4 only vs acute infection; Tables 1-2 give sequences.
exact_quote: some miRNAs were up-regulated in C6-L cells compared with both control conditions (miR-927, miR-87, miR-2a-3p, miR-190, and miR-970) or down-regulated (miR-263a-3p, miR-92b, miR-9a-1, miR-9a-5p, miR-286a, and miR-286b), but others were altered only compared with acutely infected C6/36-HT cells.
quote_locator: Section 3.2, p.5 (approx.); Table 1 p.141; Table 2 p.142
coverage_gap: Table 1 gives miR-252 and miR-263a-3p the same sequence. miR-210 vs mock has p = 0.1665.

finding: miR-927 down in acute infection at 24-48 h, then up; up in persistent infection.
exact_quote: in acutely infected C6/36 cells, miR-927 was downregulated, but its expression was gradually and directly increased as a function of the duration of infection and the m.o.i. used
coverage_gap: Arm not stated in the main text.

finding: No miRNA change survives multiple-testing correction in DENV2-infected Aag2 cells.
exact_quote: After p-value correction for multiple testing, no change in miRNA expression is statistically significant.
coverage_gap: Table S1 still has one Miesen 2016 row (miR-11900, down).

finding: Reports isomiR class shifts and arm switching under DENV, not differential expression of mature miRNAs.
exact_quote: The 3′ multiple nucleotide extension (3MNE) class of isomiRs displayed statistically significant induction in response to DENV infection in miR-285-3p, miR-989-3p and miR-10-5p
coverage_gap: Table S1 has two Etebari 2015 rows (miR-276-3p, miR-10-5p) based on isomiR ratios.

finding: 143 DE miRNAs in C6/36 cells, but after DENV-1, not DENV-2.
exact_quote: our newly annotated Ae. albopictus miRNAs in C6/36 cells were differentially expressed after 3 days post-infection with DENV1. A total of 143 miRNAs were found to be differentially expressed (p-value < 0.05)
coverage_gap: Wrong serotype; DE list in Supplemental Table S2 (unavailable).

finding: Small RNA profiles mapped to transcript targets; no list of DE miRNAs.
exact_quote: sRNA profiles are altered early in DENV2 infection, and mRNA targets from mitochondrial, transcription/translation, and transport functional categories are affected.
coverage_gap: No named DE miRNAs to extract.
